recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Dreams
recipes.description: A silky tomato sauce softened with cream, tossed through pasta with Parmesan and torn basil.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp fine salt, plus salt for pasta water
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Salt it and cook the pasta for the time on its packet. Reserve 150 ml cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-low heat. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute without browning.
Add tomatoes and 1/4 tsp salt. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
Lower the heat and stir in the cream. Add pasta and 30 ml reserved water; toss for 1 minute, adding more water a tablespoon at a time if needed.
Remove from heat. Stir in Parmesan and torn basil, season with pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Garden Pesto Twirls
recipes.description: Fresh basil pesto with toasted pine nuts, loosened with pasta water so it clings to every twist.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp fine salt, plus salt for pasta water
steps: Cook fusilli in boiling salted water following the packet instructions. Reserve 150 ml cooking water before draining.
Toast pine nuts in a dry frying pan over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes, shaking frequently, until lightly golden. Transfer to a plate to cool.
Pulse basil, pine nuts, Parmesan, peeled garlic, oil, lemon juice and 1/4 tsp salt in a food processor until a coarse paste forms.
Off the heat, toss pasta with pesto and 30 ml cooking water. Add more water as needed for a glossy coating. Taste for pepper and serve.
recipes.allergens: wheat, milk, pine nuts. Check ingredient labels.

recipes.title: Slow Sunday Pancakes
recipes.description: A small stack of fluffy pancakes with berries and maple syrup, for mornings with nowhere to be.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a bowl. Whisk egg, milk and melted butter separately.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir just until no dry flour remains. Small lumps are fine. Rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat and brush with some cooking butter. Spoon in 3 portions of batter, about 60 ml each, leaving space between them.

Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles appear and edges begin to set. Flip and cook for another 1–2 minutes, until golden with no wet batter in the centre. Reduce heat if browning too quickly; repeat with remaining batter.
Serve with berries and maple syrup.
recipes.allergens: wheat, milk, egg. Check ingredient labels.

recipes.title: Lemon & Pea Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy risotto stirred slowly with warm stock, brightened with lemon and sweet peas.
ingredients: 700 ml hot vegetable stock, plus a little hot water if needed
steps: Keep stock warm in a saucepan over low heat. In a separate wide pan, heat oil and soften onion over medium-low heat for 6 minutes, stirring without browning.
Add rice and stir for 1 minute. Add 100 ml stock and stir until mostly absorbed.

Add further stock about 100 ml at a time, stirring frequently and letting each addition mostly absorb. Maintain a gentle simmer for about 18–22 minutes total, until rice is tender with a slight bite; use hot water if stock runs out.
Stir peas into the rice for the last 4 minutes of cooking. The finished risotto should spread gently when spooned onto a plate, so add a splash of liquid if stiff.
Take off heat. Stir in butter, Parmesan, lemon zest and juice. Rest for 2 minutes, taste for seasoning and serve.
recipes.allergens: milk, check stock label. Check ingredient labels.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato & White Bean Soup
recipes.description: Oven-roasted tomatoes, onion and garlic blended with white beans into a thick, warming soup.
ingredients: 400 g can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat oven to 200°C conventional or 180°C fan. Put tomatoes, onion and garlic on a rimmed roasting tray; toss with oil, salt and pepper.
Roast for 30–35 minutes, until tomatoes collapse and onion is tender, stirring once halfway through.
Scrape vegetables and all tray juices into a saucepan. Add beans and stock; bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add basil and blend with a stick blender, keeping its head submerged to avoid splashes. Add a little water if too thick. Taste and serve hot.
recipes.allergens: check stock label. Check ingredient labels.

recipes.title: Garlic Mushroom Bruschetta
recipes.description: Browned garlicky mushrooms with thyme and parsley, piled onto crisp sourdough toast.
steps: Toast bread until crisp and golden. Keep warm while cooking the mushrooms.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms in a single layer and cook for 4 minutes before stirring.
Stir and cook for 3–4 minutes more, until released moisture has evaporated and mushrooms are browned.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter, garlic, thyme and salt; stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Add parsley, lemon juice and pepper.
Spoon mushrooms and pan juices over toast and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Crispy Chickpea & Couscous Bowls
recipes.description: Spiced roasted chickpeas over couscous with cucumber, tomatoes and a lemon yogurt dressing.
ingredients: 400 g can chickpeas, drained, rinsed and dried well
150 ml boiling water, or quantity specified on packet
steps: Heat oven to 220°C conventional or 200°C fan. Toss dry chickpeas with oil, paprika, cumin and salt on a roasting tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp outside.
Place couscous in a heatproof bowl. Add boiling water as directed on its packet, cover and stand for 5 minutes or the packet time. Fluff with a fork.
Mix yogurt with lemon juice. Divide couscous, cucumber and tomatoes between bowls.
Top with hot chickpeas, yogurt dressing and parsley. Serve immediately for the best crunch.

recipes.title: Spinach & Ricotta Pasta Bake
recipes.description: Penne baked in tomato sauce with spinach and ricotta under a golden mozzarella top.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp fine salt, plus salt for pasta water
steps: Heat oven to 200°C conventional or 180°C fan. Cook pasta in boiling salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet time; drain.
Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook garlic for 1 minute, then add passata, oregano, salt and pepper. Simmer for 8 minutes.
Add spinach in handfuls and stir for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Fold in pasta and ricotta.
Transfer to an approximately 2-litre baking dish. Sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, until bubbling throughout and golden on top. Stand for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chili
recipes.description: A smoky, gently spiced chili of sweet potato and black beans, finished with lime and coriander.
ingredients: 400 g peeled sweet potato, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
400 g can black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook onion and pepper for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika and optional chili flakes. Stir for 1 minute.
Add sweet potato, tomatoes and stock. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add drained beans. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, until sweet potato is easily pierced with a fork and sauce has thickened. Add a splash of water if it catches before the potato is tender.
Stir in lime juice, taste for salt and pepper, and scatter over coriander. Serve in bowls.
recipes.allergens: check stock and spice labels. Check ingredient labels.

recipes.title: Warm Apple & Oat Crumble
recipes.description: Cinnamon apples under a buttery oat crumble, baked until the juices bubble at the edges.
ingredients: 600 g apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1 cm pieces
30 g light brown sugar for the fruit
40 g light brown sugar for topping
steps: Heat oven to 190°C conventional or 170°C fan. Toss apples with lemon juice, 30 g sugar, cinnamon and water in an approximately 1.5-litre baking dish.
Rub cold butter into flour with your fingertips until coarse crumbs form. Stir in oats, 40 g sugar and salt.
Scatter topping evenly over apples without pressing it down.
Bake for 35–40 minutes, until topping is golden, fruit juices bubble at the edges and apple pieces feel tender when pierced. If topping browns before fruit softens, cover loosely with foil.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving; the fruit will be very hot.
recipes.allergens: wheat, oats, milk. Check ingredient labels.

brand.name: Whisker & Heat
brand.promise: A little kitchen chaos. Something delicious to cook.

film.title: Welcome to the kitchen.
film.text: Our first taste of the kitchen. Press play and turn up the sound. Meet the new story cast below.

cast.title: Meet the troublemakers.
cast.text: Luna, Simba, Nico and Milo are on the trail of a lost recipe book. Their stories are fictional. The recipes are for your real kitchen.

characters.name: Luna
characters.bio: Clever, elegant and endlessly curious. Luna can spot an ingredient by its scent, but a mystery can distract her from her own cooking.
characters.relationship: She suspects Milo, yet quietly relies on his observations.
characters.flaw: Investigates everything and sometimes forgets to finish her own cooking.
characters.comedy: Sees conspiracies in ordinary kitchen events and is often right for the wrong reason.

characters.name: Simba
characters.bio: Bold, dramatic and inventive. Simba wants to become a culinary legend; following the recipe is where things get complicated.
characters.quote: That was exactly what I meant to do!
characters.relationship: Milo loves his experiments. Nico would prefer a little order.
characters.flaw: Refuses to admit mistakes and improvises when he should follow the recipe.
characters.comedy: Turns small cooking problems into spectacular disasters, then claims it was intentional.

characters.name: Nico
characters.bio: Calm, refined and impossibly organized. Nico protects the restaurant’s reputation with perfect manners, even while dinner falls apart.
characters.quote: We can resolve this with dignity.
characters.relationship: His careful planning collides with Simba’s improvisation.
characters.flaw: Tries to solve chaos with manners and cannot tolerate disorder.
characters.comedy: Remains formal while everything around him falls apart.

characters.name: Milo
characters.bio: Sweet, curious and always hungry. Milo discovers clues by accident—provided he has not already eaten them.
characters.relationship: He adores Simba’s experiments and notices things Luna misses.
characters.flaw: Eats ingredients and evidence before anyone can inspect them.
characters.comedy: Looks harmless, causes major problems by accident, and sometimes discovers the key clue.

collections.name: Cat Chef Club
collections.text: Simba’s big ideas meet Luna’s curiosity. Follow the story, then cook the dish.

collections.name: Healthy Cat Kitchen
collections.text: Simple, balanced inspiration with clear ingredients and no miracle claims.

collections.name: Budget Cat
collections.text: Everyday ingredients, practical recipes and less waste. No invented price promises.

collections.name: Naughty Cat Café
collections.text: Nico tries to run a perfect shift. Milo keeps checking the pastries.

collections.name: Passport of Flavors
collections.text: Explore dishes and flavours with the whole kitchen crew.

collections.name: Weekly Cat Kitchen
collections.text: Choose a few meals for the week and turn the ingredients into a useful shopping list.

collections.name: Purr & Presence Kitchen
collections.text: Slow moments, comforting recipes and the pleasure of cooking.

collections.name: Cook, Play & Share
collections.text: Recipes to try together. Audience challenges and community submissions are planned for a later release.

season.title: The Lost Recipe Book
season.teaser: One missing cookbook. Four very different cats. Follow the mystery from the first kitchen disaster to a restaurant that changes everything.
season.text: A legendary cookbook has disappeared from a city run by cats. Luna, Simba, Nico and Milo follow a trail through kitchens, bakeries and night markets. These episodes are in development; the recipes are ready to explore.
season.status: Video production has not started for this episode.

episodes.title: The Worst Chef in the World
episodes.text: Simba promises the city's best dinner. A sequence of kitchen mishaps sends a dish to the most feared food critic. The critic asks for another serving, for a reason no one understands. The incident reveals the first clue connected to the missing book.

episodes.title: The Croissant Criminal
episodes.text: Croissants disappear from the bakery. Luna investigates and finds crumbs on Milo. The crumbs lead to a hidden room and an unexpected symbol.

episodes.title: Michelin Star Disaster
episodes.text: Nico hosts a high-stakes dinner. Simba changes the menu at the last minute. A guest's allergy forces the team to stop, communicate clearly, and prepare a safe alternative; the clue comes from the original menu notes, not from risking anyone's safety.

episodes.title: The 60-Second Cooking War
episodes.text: The four compete in a timed cooking challenge. Milo wins by accident and receives a box containing the first clear clue.

episodes.title: The Midnight Kitchen
episodes.text: The team sneaks into a closed restaurant to investigate a legendary recipe. Their rival is already there, cooking the same dish.

episodes.title: The Market of Impossible Ingredients
episodes.text: The team searches a night market for an unusual ingredient. Simba trades away something valuable for the wrong item. The item contains a hidden message.

episodes.title: My Ex Is a Famous Chef
episodes.text: Nico's old culinary rival returns. He insists he is unaffected and begins obsessively arranging cutlery. The rival knows where a missing page may be.

episodes.title: The Great Flour Explosion
episodes.text: A misunderstanding causes a flour cloud to cover the kitchen. Cleaning up reveals a symbol hidden on the wall.

episodes.title: The Secret Recipe
episodes.text: The team finds an incomplete recipe and argues over its meaning. Luna recognizes the code, but the solution changes how the team understands the missing book.

episodes.title: The Restaurant That Changed Everything
episodes.text: The team opens a restaurant around their first recovered recipe. An anonymous letter arrives: “If you found the first page, you still don't know who stole the book.”

community.title: Cook, Play & Share
community.text: Polls on the next dish, kitchen challenges and a place to share what you cooked are planned for a later release. They will open once reporting, moderation and privacy controls are ready, so nothing here is live yet.

notes.allergy: Allergen notes come from the ingredient list. If you have a serious allergy, always check ingredient labels and cross-contamination risks.
notes.cats: These recipes are for people. Luna, Simba, Nico and Milo are fictional; please do not feed human recipes to real cats.
